# Geometry

* [Fractal](fractal.md) - A complex geometric shape exhibiting self-similarity (or self-affinity) at multiple scales, characterized by a non-integer fractal dimension and often generated by recursive or iterative processes.
* [Self-Affinity](self-affinity.md) - Property of a fractal that resembles itself under anisotropic scaling (different scaling factors along different axes).
* [Self-Similarity](self-similarity.md) - Property of a fractal that appears the same (up to uniform isotropic scaling) when zoomed into any of its parts.
